basic_details.job_title: IBPS Clerk Notification 2026 (CRP CSA-XVI) Short Notice Out, Apply Online from August 1
basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the short notice for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026 under Advertisement No. CRP CSA-XVI, for recruitment of Customer Service Associate (CSA)/Clerical Cadre posts in participating public sector banks. The short notice was released on 27 July 2026, and the detailed notification is expected on 31 July/1 August 2026, with online applications opening from 1 August 2026.

application_fee.details: Mode of Payment: Online only (Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, UPI). | PNB LBO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 545 Local Bank Officer Posts

age_limit.details: Minimum Age: 20 years Maximum Age: 28 years Cut-off date for age calculation: 01.08.2026 Age relaxation applicable as per rules for reserved categories

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Any Graduate + Computer Literacy & Local Language Proficiency

qualification.details: Eligibility is assessed as on 01.08.2026. | Union Bank of India SO Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 395 Officer & Specialist Officer Posts

vacancy_details.details: The total number of vacancies for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026 (CRP CSA-XVI) has not been released yet and is expected to be updated along with the detailed notification.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be placed in the Clerical Cadre with a pay scale of ₹24,050 – ₹64,480/- per month, along with other allowances as applicable at the respective participating public sector bank.

selection_process: Stage 1: Online Preliminary Examination Stage 2: Online Main Examination Stage 3: Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) Stage 4: Document Verification Stage 5: Medical Examination

syllabus.details: Candidates preparing for the IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026 should have a clear understanding of the latest exam syllabus and pattern before starting their preparation. The IBPS Clerk selection process consists of a Preliminary Examination and a Main Examination, covering subjects such as English Language, Reasoning Ability, Quantitative Aptitude, General/ Financial Awareness, and Computer Aptitude. A thorough knowledge of the syllabus helps candidates prepare strategically and improve their chances of qualifying both stages. | Check IBPS Clerk Syllabus 2026

how_to_apply: Click on the "CRP CSA" section on the homepage and select "CRP CSA XVI".
Click on "Click Here for New Registration" and complete basic registration to generate a Registration ID and Password.
Log in between 1 August 2026 and 21 August 2026, and fill out the detailed online application form accurately.
Upload required scanned documents, including photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and 10th certificate.
Pay the prescribed application fee via online payment options (Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, UPI).
Submit the application form and print a copy of the final application receipt for future reference.
important_instructions: Read the detailed notification carefully once released before applying. Ensure eligibility criteria are met on the specified cut-off date. Keep scanned copies of all required documents ready before starting the application. Application fee, once paid, is generally non-refundable. Retain the final application printout for future reference.

Candidates who have completed their graduation can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and Bank Jobs 2026. Those preparing for banking exams may also check IBPS PO Recruitment 2026 and other All India Government Jobs for more opportunities.

The IBPS Clerk selection process consists of a Preliminary Examination and a Main Examination, covering subjects such as English Language, Reasoning Ability, Quantitative Aptitude, General/ Financial Awareness, and Computer Aptitude. content_sections.text: Recent passport-size photograph Scanned signature Left thumb impression Handwritten declaration 10th certificate (for age/date of birth proof) Educational qualification certificates Category certificate (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: IBPS Clerk Last Date to Apply Online
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in the IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026 (CRP CSA-XVI) must complete the online application process within the prescribed dates. As per the official schedule, the online application window will remain open from 1 August 2026 to 21 August 2026 (11:59 PM). Candidates are advised not to wait until the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues or heavy website traffic

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website www.ibps.in. Click on the "CRP CSA" section on the homepage and select "CRP CSA XVI". Click on "Click Here for New Registration" and complete basic registration to generate a Registration ID and Password. Log in between 1 August 2026 and 21 August 2026, and fill out the detailed online application form accurately. Upload required scanned documents, including photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and 10th certificate. Pay the prescribed application fee via online payment options (Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, UPI). Submit the application form and print a copy of the final application receipt for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. When was the IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026 notification released?
faq.answer: The short notice was released on 27 July 2026, with the detailed notification expected on 31 July/1 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026 apply online dates?
faq.answer: Online applications can be submitted from 1 August 2026 (12:01 AM) to 21 August 2026 (till 11:59 PM).

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹850/- for UR/General/OBC/EWS candidates and ₹175/- for SC/ST/PWD/ESM/DESM candidates, payable online only

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 01.08.2026, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Any Graduate, along with computer literacy and local language proficiency, as specified by IBPS.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are there in IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total vacancy count has not been released yet and is expected to be updated with the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online Preliminary Examination, Online Main Examination, Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT), Document Verification, and Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q8. When will the IBPS Clerk Preliminary and Main Examinations be conducted?
faq.answer: The Preliminary Examination is scheduled for 10 & 11 October 2026, and the Main Examination for 27 December 2026.
